name: Gin
author: SquareWave Studio
description: Gin is a drum synthesiser by SquareWave Studio, based on Eric Lewis's libpo32. Open the drum engine browser with Shift + T1 and select GIN. DBOX and DRUM+ remain available.
credits: Based on libpo32 by Eric Lewis; factory sounds adapt CNTR RNDM's kits. Ported to kennel by Hundekraft
